title: LSDE 2.5.0 is out
author: djmisterjon
selftext:
\- You can now set how a word is pronounced (proper names, made-up words) without changing the displayed text.  
Right-click a word → add or edit its pronunciation  
\- Exported audio now matches the preview  
\- Blueprints tree can also show every scene in a single list

replies.body: here u go, [https://lepasoft.com/en/software/ls-dialog-editor](https://lepasoft.com/en/software/ls-dialog-editor) i guess this is it.

replies.author: djmisterjon
replies.body:
LSDE is an **i18n** tool for creating/generating data dialogues, voices, and lip syncs and translating your games of software. I mainly use it for my biggest JRPG, FCT7O, but also some small casual games.  
Here are some examples of its use.   
  
[https://x.com/LEPASOFT/status/2101341596440551635](https://x.com/LEPASOFT/status/2101341596440551635)  
You also have a docs, or it supports MCP and LLMs if you don't want to learn new software.
